verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents its own web collection: an HTML snippet and a JavaScript integration that is '100% compatible with Segment API', plus a React integration. Backend data can be sent over an HTTP API, and `identify` events are referenced by Profile Builder. However, there is no evidence of a mobile SDK, server collection is a raw HTTP API rather than an official server SDK, and the track/identify/page spec is only implied through Segment compatibility rather than documented directly. missing for 10: official mobile SDKs, official server-side SDKs, an explicitly documented tracking spec covering track/identify/page, independent hands-on corroboration across platforms

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can collect events from web, mobile, and server apps through official SDKs that implement a documented tracking spec (track, identify, page)
